original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: Name one hypothesis changed from these exact interfaces. Write a literal producer-to-consumer timeline and an arbitrary-dirty-input positive/control pair, then charge acquisition, coefficients, completion, hosting and restoration. Stop if the same slot/fiber mismatch persists or the favorable full budget already fails. A scoped independent audit remains useful; another static count is not a new completion.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Completing an already realized changed channel tests a concrete construction opportunity, instead of refining the incumbent packing. A positive local result still needs global and all-size admission.

actual_scope: In the F_2^4 chart family C_u of the uniform-commutation gap, an adjacent data line matches every character if and only if the exit chart and the next entrance chart are equal. All 240 port-dependent pairs fail on exactly 8 characters. Helper roles and a hosting bill are out of scope.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed producer/consumer contract escapes the chart obstruction with a full bill. The delivered P104 obstructions, including #4136, are excluded. This package changes one hypothesis of #4136: the next entrance may be any chart C_b in the same family, not only I. That is the data-line half of #4136 open question 1. It stops when every port-dependent data pair fails, and it does not build a helper block or a channel bill.
bottleneck_link: A port-dependent entrance was the stated way past the uniform chart obstruction. Inside this family it does not produce a data-line match, so that premise does not yet supply a cheaper P104 channel. No selected exponent is changed.
stop_rule: Stop once every ordered pair in this chart family is classified. Do not search a second chart family or price a hosting bill in this session.
evidence: Exact classification. verify.py prints PASS_P104_PORT_CHART_PAIR with matching_pairs 16, failing_pairs 240, failures_per_unequal_pair 8 and entrance_I_failures 15. test_verify.py prints PASS_P104_PORT_CHART_PAIR_CONTROLS controls=counts,identity,half_fail,eigenvalues,closed_form,phase,odd_set. PROOF.md gives the multiplier table. No new kappa.

open_questions.question: Does one helper block in this same chart family match on every helper role when the data charts already differ?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The card's adjacent pair has to match helper roles as well as data roles. A helper mismatch would extend the obstruction; a helper match would be the first positive half of the pair.
open_questions.first_step: Name the helper roles and write their exit and entrance charts in this C_u family.
open_questions.blocked_by: This model has no helper roles.
